title: Canonical linear scalar extension of additive first etale cohomology
statement: Let $k\to k'$ be an algebra map of fields. Let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves], and let $C'$ with maps $f',j$ be a displayed cartesian base change along $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $G,G'$ be abelian sheaves on the respective small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with natural additive section equivalences $a_U:G(U)\simeq\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and $a'_{U'}:G'(U')\simeq\Gamma(U',\mathcal O_{U'})$. Let $q:j^*G\to G'$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] have adjoint section map given under these coordinates by structural pullback. Equip $H^1(G)$ and $H^1(G')$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] with $k$- and $k'$-module structures, respectively. Assume that for every scalar there is a sheaf endomorphism which multiplies section coordinates by its structural image and induces that scalar action on cohomology. There exists a $k'$-linear equivalence $e:H^1(G')\simeq k'\otimes_k H^1(G)$ satisfying $e(H^1(q)(j^*x))=1\otimes x$ for every $x\in H^1(G)$. No finite-dimensionality, properness, smoothness, connectedness, or algebraic closedness is assumed.

proof.text: For each k-scalar, choose the two supplied structural scalar sheaf maps. Apply upperStarLowerStarAdjunction.homEquiv to their composites with q. The section equations and the displayed pullback square show the adjoint maps agree. Naturality of cohomologyMap and functoriality of H.map then prove scalar compatibility of canonical additive cohomology pullback.

Give H1(G') its restricted k-action. Build the k-linear canonical pullback and its bilinear map (b,x) mapping to b times pullback(x). AlgebraTensorModule.lift constructs β with the pure tensor formula. The kernel theorem gives injectivity by applying it to z-w, and the surjectivity theorem supplies surjectivity.
Construct LinearEquiv.ofBijective β and take its inverse. The pure tensor formula at b=1, the inverse identities, and one_smul give the required normalization on every original class.

proof_origin.place: X2 stage 3: structural scalar compatibility is proved directly by adjunction; tensor kernel and surjectivity are split off; the tensor extension and normalized inverse equivalence are constructed in Lean.

theorem exists_additive_cohomology_linear_base_change
    {k k' : Type u}
    [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve f]
    {C' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : C' ⟶ Spec (.of k')} {ι' : C' ⟶ C}
    (h : IsPullback ι' f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf C'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (a' : ∀ U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ, G'.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (ha : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (ha' : ∀ (U V : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
      a' V (G'.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a' U x))
    (q : (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').obj G ⟶ G')
    (hq : (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a' (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ ι').obj U.unop))
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').homEquiv
            G G' q).hom.app U x) =
          (Limits.pullback.fst U.unop.hom ι').appTop (a U x)))
    [Module k (Sheaf.H G 1)] [Module k' (Sheaf.H G' 1)]
    (hscalar : ∀ c : k, ∃ μ : G ⟶ G,
        (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
          let ρ : k →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp
            (f.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom)
          a U (μ.hom.app U x) = a U x * ρ c) ∧
        ∀ x : Sheaf.H G 1,
          Sheaf.H.map μ 1 x = c • x)
    (hscalar' : ∀ c : k', ∃ μ : G' ⟶ G',
        (∀ (U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
          let ρ : k' →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp
            (f'.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k')).inv.hom)
          a' U (μ.hom.app U x) = a' U x * ρ c) ∧
        ∀ x : Sheaf.H G' 1,
          Sheaf.H.map μ 1 x = c • x) :
    ∃ e : Sheaf.H G' 1 ≃ₗ[k'] (k' ⊗[k] Sheaf.H G 1),
      ∀ x, e (Sheaf.H.map q 1 (Etale.cohomologyMap ι' G 1 x)) = 1 ⊗ₜ[k] x
